findings.summary: The committed frozen-set validator cannot run because it points to data/scenarios/frozen/1.0.0 while the package stores cases under v1.0.0.
findings.resolution: Validator root now points to data/scenarios/frozen/v1.0.1 and executes from a clean extraction.

findings.summary: The package checksum inventory is incomplete and was generated before later documentation and validation files.
findings.resolution: Package checksum inventory is generated after every other file and intentionally excludes only itself.

findings.summary: All 19 opportunity.json fixtures fail the committed shared schema, so the frozen inputs cannot be passed directly to the registered components.
findings.resolution: All 19 opportunity fixtures conform to opportunity_record.schema.json.

findings.summary: All 19 human_disposition.json fixtures fail the committed shared schema, so the frozen inputs cannot be passed directly to the registered components.
findings.resolution: All 19 human fixtures conform to a committed wrapper schema; reached dispositions validate against human_disposition.schema.json.

findings.summary: Several frozen human decisions contradict the exact expected terminal outcomes.
findings.resolution: TC-06 and TC-11 escalate, TC-17 rejects, and deferred cases contain matching defer dispositions.

findings.summary: no_recommendation is modeled as a terminal case outcome even though the orchestration policy and integrated case-state schema treat it as a recommendation result followed by human defer/escalate/reject/accept disposition.
findings.resolution: No Recommendation is modeled as R-06 while TC-04, TC-09, and TC-12 terminate as human-deferred cases.

findings.summary: Assertion JSONPaths such as $.case_state.terminal_outcome, $.side_effects, and $.claims have no committed evaluation-result schema, so implementers cannot know the canonical actual-output shape.
findings.resolution: scenario_evaluation_result.schema.json defines every assertion target object.

findings.summary: The case expects the real Project 4 model to predict Audit Rights above 0.95, but the frozen source passage is a general services/governance excerpt rather than an audit-rights clause.
findings.resolution: TC-01 and TC-02 use an audit-rights-focused synthetic passage and controlled model output instead of an unsupported live expectation.

findings.summary: P3 scenarios use STG-01 through STG-12 while orchestration policy uses descriptive IDs such as load_configuration; no machine-readable mapping is committed.
findings.resolution: stage_identifier_mapping.json maps STG-01 through STG-12 to orchestration stage and component IDs.
